headlines.title: Centrica boss says he is 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
headlines.description: Chris O'Shea says the number of people unable or unwilling to pay their energy bills will increase when prices jump in the new year.

headlines.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
headlines.description: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.

headlines.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
headlines.description: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

headlines.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
headlines.description: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

headlines.title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
headlines.description: Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.
